exposure: absence of physical and verbal abuse
outcome: stated preferences for hypothetical place of delivery
choice of place of delivery (between hypothetical health facilities or home birth)
cohort: The study included a random sample of 426 women who had facility-based childbirth in rural Northeast Nigeria.
finding: The likelihood of poor facility birth experiences had a significant impact on stated preferences for place of delivery among rural women in northeast Nigeria, with good health system condition being the most important influence on choice.
cross-section timing: At the time of the discrete choice experiment
